purpose: Machine-readable description of the Calm Home TV UI (as built on a Xiaomi 27-inch Android TV) and a 40-point algorithm to rebuild it, better, as a Tizen web app for a Samsung 65-inch 4K TV.

how_to_read.units: dp = Android density-independent px on the Xiaomi (960x540 dp canvas); css = CSS px on Tizen's 1920x1080 viewport
how_to_read.node_source: authored = written for this point; derived = computed from authored data and the platform model
how_to_read.order: build points in ascending id; depends_on must be done first

hard_limits_on_samsung: Calm Home cannot be the default launcher: the Home button always opens Samsung's home screen. Workarounds: pin it first in the app bar; 'Autorun Last App' (Settings > General > Smart Features, on many models) reopens it at power-on.
Replace the Samsung home screen or Smart Hub (no third-party default launcher)
Intercept the Home, Source or Samsung app-shortcut buttons on the remote
Disable, debloat or force-stop other apps or system services
Read other apps' usage history (no UsageStats equivalent) - Calm Home keeps its own launch log

Switch HDMI inputs or read HDMI connection state without partner-level privileges (tvwindow / tv input APIs are partner-only on retail TVs) - treat as unavailable and fall back to opening Samsung's Source menu guidance
Draw system-wide overlays (no volume stepper over other apps)

current.device: Xiaomi MiTV-AXFR2 (watchmen), 27-inch-class panel driven at 1280x720 UI
current.os: Android 11 (Google TV, launcherx), Amlogic T5D, 1.5 GB RAM, 32-bit userspace
current.app: Native Android APK com.calmtv.home (Java, no Gradle: aapt2 -> javac --release 8 -> d8 -> zipalign -> apksigner)

target.role: Regular app (opened from Samsung's Smart Hub / app bar). It cannot replace the Samsung home screen.

regions.align: right edge at width - safe_x; ink-aligned via trailing-space correction

regions.y: 24dp below the lower of the two top columns

contents: one straight row of 16:9 tiles 128x72dp, gap 16dp
full-width gradient from the bottom edge, tinted with the photo's colour
up to 14 mini 16:9 cards 56x32dp, gap 12dp, half off the bottom edge, alpha 0.55
page below Home in the same window: rail + A-Z sections

wifi_chip.icon: Wi-Fi fan, dot + 3 arcs lit by level 0-4, 19x15dp
wifi_chip.focus: white fill 0xF2FFFFFF, dark text, Change turns 0xFF2F6FDE, scale 1.04 from the left edge
wifi_chip.glass: same tinted gradient as the dock

tile.recent_dot: 5dp white dot under the card when recently used
tile.caption: name under the focused card

hero.change: fade + 8dp rise, 180ms, withLayer, skipped if title unchanged

shelf.base: photo average colour, saturation x1.4+0.1, value 0.22

dock_behaviour.model: straight row, moved as one piece (row translationX), focused tile always at the focus spot (one app in from the left)
dock_behaviour.ends: row clamps so the screen stays full; holding Left/Right stops at the ends; a fresh press past 'More' jumps to the landing tile; Left from the first jumps to 'More'
dock_behaviour.landing: focus lands on the app after the PS4 tile (never on PS4)
dock_behaviour.left_visibility: tiles cut off at the left edge get alpha 0 (only full tiles show on the left)

page_slide.rule: Home and Library move together, translate only, no layers

wallpaper.settle_zoom: 1.04 -> 1.0 over 2400ms (skipped in quiet stage and right after returning from an app)
wallpaper.arrival_hold: wait for 3s without key presses before changing the photo after returning

data.wallpapers: 12 photos 960x540 ARGB_8888 + 64x36 frosted copy, shade baked in (top band, two radial pools full-canvas, bottom band)
data.recents: UsageEvents 21 days: habit within +-1h of now + recency, memoised 3 min / hour change
data.weather: Open-Meteo forecast + air quality (us_aqi), ipwho.is location, 30 min cache
data.greeting: time-of-day headline pools + context notes (AQI, rain, temperature, weekday, habits, PS4 evenings), avoids the last two shown

measured_performance_xiaomi.library_open: p90 16 ms, p99 21-24 ms (warm), first open after an app ~61 ms p99
